name: uplift-plane-page
description: Write or convert documents into Plane pages that non-developers can actually read: plain-language headings with technical detail underneath, no arrow/em-dash shorthand, no Obsidian wikilinks, mermaid rendered to images. Includes a checker, a mermaid-to-PNG renderer (Thai fonts), and a publisher for self-hosted Plane that also guards against the live-server overwrite trap. Also ships `plane-plan`: turn a set of Plane work items into a remediation plan page that matches reality, by checking each item's latest comments and the deployed branch before planning, then splitting the work into code, non-code, decisions and re-verification.
